diagnosis.overview: The agent lacks reliable tools for live data retrieval (property listings, image OCR, accurate document extraction), forcing it to fabricate generic or incorrect values, and lacks prompt-enforced verification against source documents, leading to widespread retrieval and omission failures.
diagnosis.root_cause: The agent lacks reliable tools for live data retrieval (property listings, image OCR, accurate document extraction), forcing it to fabricate generic or incorrect values, and lacks prompt-enforced verification against source documents, leading to widespread retrieval and omission failures.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: 1) Wire in web-scraping/API tools for fetching actual listings from Crexi, LoopNet, and similar platforms; 2) Wire in a robust OCR tool for extracting text from images; 3) Add a prompt rule that requires cross-checking all extracted figures and content against original source documents, and that explicitly flags any placeholder or generic data as incomplete before final output.
